events.name: Arrival at the Ardèche caves
events.notes: Day-level date only. timeline.md places the first evacuees at 06:30, while timeline_quiet_centuries_1-25.md records families moving from 05:30 and Marc arriving at 20:00. These may be different milestones; do not collapse them into a single time.

events.name: The first night at Mponeng Deep
events.notes: Provisional day-level anchor. The available chronology establishes that people were already below ground at the activation, but does not document the first-night sequence.

events.name: First underground stabilization
events.notes: Provisional early population-level stabilization period. The early chronicle describes the underground population as stabilizing by October 2035; later global stabilization estimates refer to a different period. Keep this broad range until the chronology is reconciled.

events.name: Material presence of the first Crystals
events.notes: The previous 2041 CE / 7 AS date is no longer canonical. Material Crystal presence is placed around 200 AS by canon decision, but the exact event date remains undocumented.
